app.title: CareerForge AI
hero.headline: Build ATS-Friendly Resumes — Free, Local, Open Source
hero.subheadline: Edit locally, analyse with 5-axis ATS scoring, and export in minutes
hero.trust: Your data stays on your device — no account, no cloud, no tracking
features.title: Built for engineers
features.subtitle: Every feature is designed around the real workflow of a software engineer applying for jobs.
features.builder.title: Smart Resume Builder
features.builder.desc: Real-time editing, drag-and-drop sections, live preview, autosave, and full version history.
features.ats.title: 5-Axis ATS Analysis
features.ats.desc: Content, Format, ATS, Brevity, Impact scoring with per-deduction fixes.
features.helpers.title: Smart Local Helpers
features.helpers.desc: Action-verb swap, bullet rewriter, metric prompter, achievement templates, grammar checker.
features.github.title: GitHub Intelligence
features.github.desc: Import your GitHub profile and auto-generate contribution bullets, project sections, and skill lists.
features.exports.title: Multiple Exports
features.exports.desc: Export to PDF, DOCX, JSON Resume, Markdown, plain TXT — all ATS compliant.
features.templates.title: Professional Templates
features.templates.desc: Classic ATS, Modern Professional, Executive — with column layout and picture options.
how.title: From blank to hired in three steps
how.step1.title: Fill in your details
how.step1.desc: Start from a pre-filled sample or paste in your existing experience. No account required.
how.step2.title: Analyse & optimise
how.step2.desc: Run ATS analysis, use Quick Actions to swap weak verbs, add metrics, match against JDs.
how.step3.title: Export & apply
how.step3.desc: Download a pixel-perfect PDF or DOCX, or generate a portfolio site — in one click.
oss.title: Fully open source — MIT Licensed
oss.desc: Read the code, self-host it, contribute to it, or fork it. CareerForge AI is built in the open.
